verdict.line: You lose if Garen stacks Judgment and E-Q poke you down before you can commit Jousting; you win if you bait Decisive Strike's silence early and snowball with Violent Tendencies trades.

brief.thesis: This is a 47.5% matchup over 118 games precisely because both champions win trades through sustained extended combat rather than burst — Garen's Perseverance heals him back between skirmishes while your Skaarl health bar functions the same way, so whoever forces more total fighting time without overcommitting into the other's cooldown windows wins the lane.

theirWindow.what: He'll engage the moment it's up since the attack silences you and removes your Pocket Pistol or Bear Trap as an escape/punish tool. Don't walk into melee range when his Q icon is lit.

yourWindow.when: His Q (Decisive Strike) just used, 8s window
yourWindow.what: This is your trade window. Go in with E (Jousting) for the dash damage and speed, then W (Violent Tendencies) to stack your four empowered attacks while he has no silence or gap-close available.

start.why: 45.7% win rate over 116 games at 80% pick — the lifesteal and AD let you win the extended trades this matchup is decided by, while the potion offsets Garen's passive sustain so he can't out-heal you between skirmishes.

boots.why: 47.6% win rate over 103 games at 75.7% pick — Garen's trade pattern leans on his auto attacks plus E (Judgment) spin damage, and the reduced auto-attack damage directly blunts both.

core.why: The wave-clear and bonus health let you force more total fight time, which is exactly the resource this matchup is won on
Keeps your siege and split-push threat relevant if the lane stalls into an even stalemate
The health and damage reduction buffer against his R (Demacian Justice) execute threshold once you're both over level 14

situational.when: the lane is going even and you need armor shred to win longer trades
he's building tanky and you need the sustain to out-trade his Perseverance regen
you're ahead and want to close out fights faster before his R comes online

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force rewards exactly the prolonged trading this matchup demands, and it directly counters Garen's Perseverance sustain by out-healing or out-damaging his regen in extended fights

summoners.why: 69.4% pick at 50% win rate — Ignite's burn denies Garen's Perseverance passive heal during and after trades, which is the single biggest lever in this matchup since his whole kit leans on that regen between skirmishes

playing.title: Trade only after his Q is spent
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's silence is 8s on cooldown and removes your Bear Trap or Pocket Pistol as a tool for the duration. Wait for him to use it on a minion or on you before committing your E (Jousting) engage.

playing.title: Use Ignite to deny his passive sustain
playing.detail: Garen regenerates a percentage of total health per second when untouched by Perseverance. Landing Ignite mid or post-trade shuts this off completely and turns close fights in your favor.

playing.title: Double-dash E (Jousting) around his E (Judgment)
playing.detail: His spin only hits nearby enemies, so use the recast on Jousting to dash back out through him right as the spin ends rather than sitting in range for a second rotation.

playing.title: Stack W (Violent Tendencies) before all-ins
playing.detail: Pop your four empowered attacks before he gets his E (Judgment) off cooldown so the trade favors your burst window instead of his sustained spin damage.

playing.title: Respect his R (Demacian Justice) past level 6
playing.detail: It's an execute on low health with a long cooldown that drops from 140s to 20s as it ranks — don't dive into kill range under 50% HP once he's 6+ unless you can burst him first.

playing.title: Use R (Chaaaaaaaarge!!!) to punish overextension
playing.detail: The global range lets you collapse on him if he pushes past minion wave without backup, especially once your jungler or mid can follow the ram.

playing.title: Remount fights to reset tempo
playing.detail: Fighting while dismounted restores Skaarl's courage, so use Pocket Pistol pokes to rebuild toward a remount rather than disengaging entirely.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the matchup mechanics, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are the author's own analysis.
